summary: Ran check_citation on the 12 most load-bearing reference ids (42774067, 42489969, 40846977, 42432192, 42573891, 42429864, 42013553, NCT06556706, NCT07231848, NCT07517913, NCT07782671, 42616901). All identifiers resolve; fetched titles are topically consistent with the record digest in most cases, and two draft claims were positively corroborated by the live registry: (a) 42432192's "HFpEF" label is confirmed by its live title ("...ameliorate cardiac remodeling in HFpEF"); (b) the Methods-section correction that 42616901 is a PKGIα-targeting study, not urolithin A, is confirmed by its live title and was correctly excluded from the urolithin evidence base. Blocking problems remain: six numeric/qualifier claims have no provenance in the provided StudyRecords (n=28, n=48, n=40 CSF, n=250, n=40 AIRE, and the "single uncontrolled case n=1 / modest clinical response" phrasing for the niacin case), two fabricated detail claims ("placebo-controlled double-blind" for NCT06556706; "mitochondrial progeria model" for 42669151), and two disease-model labeling issues raised by live titles (40846977 fetched as "NAD(+) dyshomeostasis in RYR1-related myopathies", which does not clearly evidence an NR intervention in patient-derived myotubes or a primary mitochondrial disease population; 42573891 fetched as a diabetic-mice fibrosis study and 42013553 as a trimethyltin chloride myocardial-injury study, both framed under the "CHF" umbrella). Direction and phase fidelity otherwise match the records; the four pipeline-only NCTs are correctly coded as direction=unclear. Not approved: 10 findings (6 REMOVE, 2 FIX, 2 VERIFY) must be resolved first.

findings.issue: Sample size "n=28" for 40846977 has no provenance: the record lists only outcome directions (cellular NAD+, maximal respiration, ATP: positive) with no n.

findings.location: Section 1 (Summary), bullet 3 — urolithin A human evidence
findings.issue: Sample size "n=48" for the phase 1 bioavailability trial has no provenance in record NCT07231848 (record lists only the concentration-time profile endpoint, direction unclear).

findings.location: Section 1 (Summary), bullet 3 — urolithin A human evidence
findings.issue: Sample size "n=40" for the CSF-kinetics study has no provenance in record NCT07517913 (record lists only "urolithin A kinetics in CSF: unclear").
Sample size "n=250" for the phase 3 PAD trial has no provenance in record NCT07782671. (The "eight endpoints including MRI ASL" part is supported by the record and may stay.)
Sample size "n=40" for the AIRE observational record has no provenance in record NCT06941584 (record lists only "diagnostic accuracy: unclear").

"единичном неконтролируемом кейсе ниацина (n=1)" and "клинический ответ — скромным" have no provenance: record 39173541 gives no n, no control design, and no "clinical response" outcome; its coding is disease progression: neutral (metabolomics: positive, amino acids: neutral). "Скромный ответ" also misrepresents a neutral direction as a small positive response.
findings.action: REMOVE "(n=1)", "неконтролируемом" and "скромным"; rephrase as: "прогрессирование заболевания — нейтральное (по кодированию записи)".

findings.location: Section 1 (Summary), bullet 3 — urolithin A frailty RCT
findings.issue: "плацебо-контролируемое двойное слепое RCT" invents design details: record NCT06556706 is coded only [rct] and the live registry title ("Impact of Urolithin A (Mitopure) on Mitochondrial Quality in Muscle of Frail Older Adults") does not confirm blinding or a placebo control.
findings.action: FIX — delete "плацебо-контролируемое двойное слепое"; keep "RCT при синдроме хрупкости у пожилых (NCT06556706)".

findings.issue: "в модели митохондриальной прогерии" invents a specific disease: record 42669151 only states the preclinical study is "in primary mitochondrial diseases"; "progeria" appears nowhere in the provided records.
findings.action: FIX — replace with "в доклинической модели при первичных митохондриальных заболеваниях (42669151)".

findings.location: Section 1 (Summary), bullet 1 — preclinical NR effect claim
findings.issue: Citation check for 40846977 fetched "NAD(+) dyshomeostasis in RYR1-related myopathies", which does not clearly evidence an NR-intervention study in patient-derived myotubes, and RYR1-related myopathy is not a primary mitochondrial disease as labeled in the record and draft.
findings.action: VERIFY — re-confirm that 40846977 reports NR effects (NAD+, maximal respiration, ATP) in patient-derived myotubes and correct the population label; if it cannot be confirmed, remove the claim from the summary.

findings.location: Section 1 (Summary), bullet 2 — CHF umbrella for NMN and luteolin
findings.issue: Live titles contradict the "ХСН" framing: 42573891 fetched as NMN in "Diabetic Mice" (myocardial fibrosis, SIRT3/GSK3β/Smad3) and 42013553 fetched as luteolin protection in trimethyltin chloride–induced myocardial injury — neither title states a chronic heart failure model, though the record digest labels both as CHF.
findings.action: VERIFY — confirm the disease models for 42573891 and 42013553; if they are not CHF models, reframe the bullet (e.g., "модели сердечно-сосудистого/кардиомиоцитарного повреждения") instead of listing them under ХСН.
